dataset: Deterministic 100k-line Rust file; 1,000 typed chars; 10 s smooth scroll; 100 window resizes
success_threshold: Instrumentation overhead <=2%; after refactor p95 and p99 latency <= baseline*1.05 and skipped frames do not increase
notes: Requires feature-gated FrameEvent/FrameTimingCollector port before any structural refactor.

workload: Cached and dirty view render cost
dataset: Editor, workspace tabs, command palette, settings; unchanged frame plus single-entity update
metric: request_layout, prepaint, paint, scene replay duration and counts
success_threshold: Unchanged cached frame reuses the same or more view ranges; dirty single-entity p95 total phase cost <= baseline*1.05
notes: Falsifies any invalidation redesign that broadens work.

dataset: Fixed scene corpus: text/emoji/SVG/images/clips/shadows/paths at 1x and 2x
metric: Pixel diff, render completion, GPU adapter availability, wall time
success_threshold: Linux and Windows software/hardware adapters render every scene; <=0.5% differing pixels after per-platform approved baselines; no hangs in 100 runs
notes: Prototype from gpui-ce WgpuHeadlessRenderer; do not replace macOS visual tests until proven.

workload: Extract narrow platform and renderer contracts behind compatibility re-exports
dataset: cargo check graph for gpui, platform crates, zzz default member
metric: Clean/incremental wall time, rebuilt crate count, dependency edges, source edits
success_threshold: No product crate source edits; no dependency cycle; platform-only edit rebuilds <= current rebuilt crate count; clean check <= baseline*1.10
notes: Start as internal modules, then compare before creating new crates.

workload: Separate Scene/atlas/renderer contract from App/Window runtime
dataset: Existing GPUI examples plus editor_render benchmark scene corpus
metric: API migration count, render equivalence, compile time, binary size
success_threshold: Compatibility facade yields 0 consumer edits; golden scene output unchanged; clean build <= baseline*1.10; binary size <= baseline*1.03
notes: Fails if Scene cannot be detached without proliferating shared-type crates.

workload: Core semantics and native adapter integration
dataset: Button, input, editor, list/tree, tabs, dialogs, status notifications on macOS/Windows/Linux
metric: Semantic snapshot, action dispatch, focus mapping, platform walkthrough
success_threshold: All named interactive controls appear with role/name/state; accessible actions mutate once; keyboard focus matches accessibility focus; VoiceOver/Narrator/Orca smoke passes
notes: Component snapshots are necessary but do not substitute for native screen-reader QA.

dataset: 10 representative components and editor viewport updates
metric: Nodes/views reprocessed, frame phase time, correctness assertions
success_threshold: At least 20% less phase work in targeted cases with no pixel/input/focus divergence; otherwise reject the added invalidation API
notes: Only after EXP-001/002 establish a measurable bottleneck.

dataset: Background-to-main handoff, timers, cancellation, window teardown; 100 randomized seeds
metric: Completion time, hangs, races, teardown leaks, deterministic-test parity
success_threshold: 0 hangs/panics/leaks in 100 runs; all deterministic assertions also pass; benchmark variance CV <=10% after warmup
notes: Keep virtual-clock TestDispatcher for ordinary unit tests.

dataset: Latin dead keys, CJK preedit, emoji, RTL, multi-cursor composition, accessibility keyboard on macOS/Linux/Windows/Web
metric: Committed text, marked range, selection, candidate bounds, undo grouping
success_threshold: All existing editor IME tests pass; platform scripts match expected UTF-16 ranges and cursor bounds; no lost/duplicated commit in 100 repetitions
notes: Use a narrow text-input client interface; Web gaps may remain explicitly unsupported.

workload: Remove static editor factory and relocate product prompt integration
dataset: ui_input, editor, workspace security modal, ui_prompt startup
metric: Changed public APIs, consumer edits, initialization-order failures, incremental compile time
success_threshold: No process-global factory; startup-order test passes; <=10 consumer call-site changes; editor-only change no longer recompiles generic UI components where avoidable
notes: A compatibility adapter may be kept for one release.

workload: Frame and layout allocation regression gate
dataset: Warm editor render, 1,000 scroll frames, 1,000 workspace layout resizes
success_threshold: No-op/cached frame allocations <= baseline; refactor allocations and peak RSS <= baseline*1.03
notes: Adapt gpui-profiler-style probes; exclude allocator/coverage instrumentation noise.

workload: One isolated low-risk component rewritten with gpui-rsx-style proc macro
dataset: Single settings panel component with equivalent builder version
metric: Clean/incremental compile time, diagnostics quality, source LOC, debugger usability
success_threshold: Proceed only if incremental compile <= baseline*1.05, generated errors identify source spans, and maintainers prefer the result; otherwise reject
notes: Not part of core architecture and scheduled only after stable public APIs.
